units.source_text: ……这是进入大学预科的翌年，即1948年春假的事。

en.t: ... This happened during spring break in 1948, the year after I entered the university preparatory course.
One evening, the teacher went out.

units.source_text: 我没有朋友，独自散步以消磨难得的自由时间。

en.t: I had no friends, so I took a walk alone to pass that rare free time.

units.source_text: 我走出寺庙，钻出了大门。

en.t: I left the temple and slipped out through the main gate.

units.source_text: 大门外侧有一道环寺庙的水沟，水沟旁立着一块告示牌。

en.t: Outside the main gate, there was a ditch encircling the temple, and beside it stood a notice board.
